customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as env vars in CI workflows. The github-actions manager only looks at `uses:` lines, so these need their own manager. Annotate a variable with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [extractVersion=...]` comment on the line above it. extractVersion is set per annotation because the tag formats differ (vX.Y.Z, kustomize/vX.Y.Z, none on PyPI).

packageRules.description: A human gate for images this repo runs as stateful apps. Renovate can and does automerge these -- it shipped immich v3.2.2 straight to production on 2026-09-27, unreviewed -- and that is what this rule stops. Automerge stays on for Docker Hub images, whose blast radius is smaller here. minimumReleaseAge is dropped rather than kept: the soak exists to let other people hit a regression before a robot merges it, but once a human decides the timing the soak only delays the notification, and a PR nobody has seen yet is not a risk. Must stay AFTER the matchUpdateTypes rules above -- packageRules are applied in order, last match wins.

The authentik backup and restore-verify images must keep the PostgreSQL major of the server deployed by the authentik chart (17): a newer pg_dump writes archives the server's pg_restore 17 cannot read, so a real restore would fail. Patch and minor 17.x updates still flow. Lift this together with the server's major.
